scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('index.dev.html','index.html')" && vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('docs/index.html','index.html'); fs.cpSync('docs/assets','assets',{recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('docs/film.mp4')) fs.copyFileSync('docs/film.mp4','film.mp4'); if(fs.existsSync('docs/robots.txt')) fs.copyFileSync('docs/robots.txt','robots.txt'); else if(fs.existsSync('robots.txt')) fs.copyFileSync('robots.txt','docs/robots.txt');"
